description_en: Calls DescribeLivePullToPush to query a pull-to-push streaming task
description_zh: 调用DescribeLivePullToPush查询拉流转推任务
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-pull-to-push --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id fd245384-4067-4f91-9d75-9666a6bc0000 --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en:

- ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
- ap-southeast-5 (Indonesia)
- cn-beijing (Beijing)
- cn-shanghai (Shanghai)
